name: How long does a typical interior woodwork repair project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical interior woodwork repair project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of an interior woodwork repair project varies significantly based on the size and complexity of the repair. Simple repairs like filling small dents or scratches might take only a few hours. More extensive work, such as repairing multiple pieces of trim, addressing significant water damage, or custom color matching, could take several days to a week or more. The drying time for fillers, stains, and finishes also adds to the overall timeline. Understanding the scope upfront helps set accurate expectations for project completion.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration varies by repair size and complexity. Simple repairs take hours, while extensive work with drying times can take days to over a week.
